blind.description: A stylized fantasy cuirass or torso armor consisting of a front breastplate with central ridge, matching backplate, and layered waist rim. Two brown leather shoulder straps with brass or gold buckles and rivets bridge the top across the arm and neck openings. Materials are clean dark burnished steel with brass/bronze trim and brown leather. All surfaces are solid, continuous, and cleanly modeled without floating artifacts, holes, or melted geometry.
blind.from_above: An oval central neck opening ringed in metal, bordered on left and right by brown leather shoulder straps with gold buckles, forming a rounded rectangular torso silhouette.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2 feet tall (roughly one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1.5 feet wide across the shoulders.

notes: underside: the mesh's middle is not over what touches the floor (leaning or cantilevered)
